content.text:
Here are some good places to get **free 3D game assets**:

| Site | Best for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Kenney** | Low-poly game-ready packs | Great for prototypes; many assets are public-domain/CC0-style. |
| **Quaternius** | Characters, creatures, vehicles, props | Lots of stylized low-poly packs; often CC0/free. |
| **Poly Haven** | HDRIs, textures, realistic models | High-quality assets, generally **CC0**. Good for environments/materials. ([dev.polyhaven.com](https://dev.polyhaven.com/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **OpenGameArt** | Mixed 2D/3D/game assets | Check each asset’s license carefully; licenses vary. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenGameArt.org?utm_source=openai)) |
| **itch.io free assets** | Indie asset packs | Search tags like `3D`, `low-poly`, `FBX`, `GLTF`, `Unity`, `Godot`. |
| **Sketchfab** | Individual models | Use the “Downloadable” filter and check the license. |
| **Mixamo** | Humanoid characters + animations | Useful for rigged characters and animation prototyping. |
| **KayKit / Kay Lousberg** | Cute low-poly packs | Some packs have free versions, often good for Unity/Godot/Unreal. ([kaylousberg.itch.io](https://kaylousberg.itch.io/block-bits?utm_source=openai)) |
| **FreePixel** | GLB low-poly assets | Offers free GLB models ready for engines like Unity, Godot, Blender, and Three.js. ([freepixel.art](https://freepixel.art/3d-assets?utm_source=openai)) |
| **FreeGameAssets.com** | Aggregated free game assets | Has categories for 3D models and asset packs from multiple sources. ([freegameassets.com](https://www.freegameassets.com/category/3d-models?utm_source=openai)) |

**Best picks if you want game-ready low-poly assets:**
1. **Kenney**
2. **Quaternius**
3. **KayKit**
4. **itch.io free 3D assets**

**Best picks if you want realistic environments/materials:**
1. **Poly Haven**
2. **ambientCG**
3. **Sketchfab**
4. **Free3D**

Quick tip: look for **CC0** assets if you want the least licensing hassle, especially for commercial games. Also prefer formats like **FBX**, **OBJ**, **GLTF**, or **GLB** for Unity, Unreal, Godot, and Blender.
